contribution_delta: A single degree-aware L2 scaling parameter added to a tuned 2-layer GCN under degree shift, avoiding multi-stage encoders and auxiliary losses.
decision_if_resolved: Adopt the minimal 1-parameter scaling if it beats the tuned 2-layer baseline by >=0.030 macro-F1; otherwise retain the unmodified 2-layer baseline.
simplest_alternative: Tuned 2-layer GCN with standard symmetric normalization (0 extra modules, 0 extra losses), scoring 0.718 macro-F1 across 5 seeds on the fixed degree-shift split.

parsimony_audit.simplest_alternative: Tuned 2-layer GCN with standard symmetric normalization (0 extra modules, 0 extra losses), scoring 0.718 macro-F1 across 5 seeds on the fixed degree-shift split.
parsimony_audit.problem_inflation_check: In-domain macro-F1 is 0.786 vs 0.718 under degree shift (-0.068 drop, 95% CI [0.054, 0.082] over 5 seeds), establishing a measured deficit rather than seed noise.
parsimony_audit.minimal_sufficient_design: One degree-aware L2 scaling coefficient added to standard 2-layer GCN propagation without extra encoders or auxiliary losses.

component_justifications.rationale: Single parameter resolves tail-degree norm shrinkage without additional layers or losses.
